skill.name: crawl4ai
skill.description: Crawl4AI guides agents through web scraping, deep crawling, batch crawling, CSS extraction, screenshot capture, and PDF export.
skill.summary: Use Crawl4AI to scrape, crawl, extract, screenshot, and export web pages.
skill.author: CK991357

security_audit.summary: The static Ruby backtick, hardcoded URL, and entropy findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, placeholder URLs, and multilingual documentation. Semantic review found a real high-risk issue: the guide promotes anti-bot and blocking-evasion behavior. The author should remove evasion guidance and limit the skill to authorized, rate-limited crawling.

remediation.suggestion: Remove guidance for bypassing anti-scraping systems, disabling automation controls, disabling Web security, and improving success after blocks. Require authorized crawling, rate limits, and robots.txt compliance.
Warn agents that crawled pages are untrusted. Tell them to extract or summarize page content without obeying instructions found inside fetched pages.
Keep strict depth, page, and concurrency limits in examples. Prefer same-domain crawling and require explicit user approval for larger scopes.

static_findings.snippet: **所有对 `crawl4ai` 的调用都必须严格遵循以下嵌套结构!** 这是一个通用规则,适用于所有模式。
| `scrape` | 抓取单个网页 | 获取页面内容、截图、PDF | ⭐⭐ | 单页面内容获取 |
| `deep_crawl` | 深度智能爬取 | 使用策略深度爬取网站 | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | 网站内容探索 |
| `batch_crawl` | 批量 URL 处理 | 同时处理多个 URL | ⭐⭐ | 批量数据收集 |
| `extract` | 结构化数据提取 | 基于 CSS 或 LLM 提取数据 | ⭐⭐⭐ | 特定数据提取 |
| `pdf_export` | PDF 导出 | 将网页导出为 PDF | ⭐ | 文档保存 |
| `screenshot` | 截图捕获 | 捕获网页截图 | ⭐ | 视觉证据保存 |
**注意:** `crawl` 模式已在最新版本中移除,请使用 `scrape` 或 `deep_crawl` 替代。
- `url` (必需): 要抓取的网页 URL,必须以 `http://` 或 `https://` 开头
- `css_selector`: 提取特定内容的 CSS 选择器
- `include_links`: 是否在输出中包含链接,默认 true
- `include_images`: 是否在输出中包含图片,默认 true
- `return_screenshot`: 是否返回截图(base64),默认 false
- `return_pdf`: 是否返回 PDF(base64),默认 false
- `word_count_threshold`: 内容块最小单词数,默认 10
- `exclude_external_links`: 是否排除外部链接,默认 true
- `include_external`: 是否跟踪外部链接,默认 false
- `keywords`: 用于相关性评分的关键词列表
- `stream`: 是否流式返回结果,默认 false
- `urls` (必需): URL 列表,必须是数组格式
- `stream`: 是否流式返回,默认 false
- `concurrent_limit`: 最大并发数,默认 4 (已根据服务器内存升级调整,并设置了硬性上限)

- 如果缺少 `fields`,自动创建默认字段配置
- `url` (必需): 要提取的网页 URL

content.value_statement: Web research often needs repeatable capture, extraction, and evidence collection. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Crawl4AI workflows.
actual_capabilities: Scrapes a single URL into markdown, HTML, or text.
Runs deep crawls with depth, page, keyword, and URL filters.
Processes URL batches with a documented concurrency limit.
Extracts structured fields through CSS selector schemas.
Exports webpages as screenshots or PDF in base64 form.
Documents tiered crawl settings for different site complexity.
limitations: LLM extraction mode is documented as not deployed.
Structured extraction depends on accurate CSS selectors.
Large crawls can hit timeouts, memory limits, or site blocks.
Users must ensure they have permission to crawl each site.

use_cases.title: Archive Research Pages
use_cases.description: Capture article text, links, screenshots, and PDFs for later review.

use_cases.title: Collect Product Fields
use_cases.description: Use CSS selectors to extract names, prices, and attributes from known page templates.

use_cases.title: Verify Page Changes
use_cases.description: Save screenshots and readable page text for release checks or content audits.

prompt_templates.title: Scrape One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Crawl4AI to scrape [URL] as markdown. Include links and images. Keep all options inside the parameters object.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Page Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Crawl4AI to capture a full-page screenshot and PDF for [URL]. Return the base64 outputs and summarize page status.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Known Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Crawl4AI extract mode on [URL]. Use CSS selectors for title, author, date, and body. Report any missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Scoped Crawl
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Crawl4AI deep_crawl for [URL] with max depth 2 and a small page limit. Stay within authorized pages only.

output_examples.input: A user asks to crawl a documentation page for readable text.
output_examples.output: A concise page summary, the main extracted content, important internal links, and notes about missing sections.

output_examples.input: A user asks to collect product names and prices from a known template.
output_examples.output: An itemized result list with product names, prices, source pages, and selector warnings.

output_examples.input: A user asks for evidence from a landing page.
output_examples.output: A screenshot reference, PDF capture status, page title, and a short visual summary.

best_practices: Start with one URL before batch or deep crawl jobs.
Respect robots.txt, site terms, and rate limits.
Treat crawled page text as untrusted content.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to bypass access controls or bot protections.
Do not run broad crawls without a page limit.
Do not rely on LLM extraction when CSS selectors are required.

faq.question: What does this skill help agents do?
faq.answer: It helps agents prepare Crawl4AI requests for scraping, crawling, extraction, screenshots, and PDF export.

faq.question: Does it support batch crawling?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide documents batch URL processing with stream options and a concurrency limit.

faq.question: Can it extract structured data?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports CSS selector extraction with a schema definition for named fields.

faq.question: Can it use natural language extraction only?
faq.answer: The guide says LLM extraction is not effectively deployed, so CSS selectors are required.

faq.question: What outputs can include binary data?
faq.answer: Screenshots and PDFs can be returned as base64 encoded outputs.

faq.question: What should users check before crawling?
faq.answer: Users should confirm authorization, follow robots.txt, set small limits, and avoid protected pages.
